spec.title: Instance role
spec.description: Whether this server accepts writes (Primary) or is read-only (Replica)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN pg_is_in_recovery() THEN 'REPLICA'
    ELSE 'PRIMARY'
  END AS server_role

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Time since the database server last restarted.

spec.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch from current_timestamp - pg_postmaster_start_time()) as "Uptime"

SELECT
  ${server_major} AS "Current",
  ${latest_major} AS "Latest"

SELECT
  ${server_minor} AS "Current",
  ${latest_minor} AS "Latest"

spec.title: Longest autovacuum run
spec.description: Duration of the longest running autovacuum. Long runs can signal workload or tuning problems.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  extract(epoch from MAX(finished_at - started_at)) AS "Max duration"
FROM
  pganalyze.vacuum_stats

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wraparound) AS "Anti-wraparound"
FROM pganalyze.vacuum_stats

SELECT
  SUM(bloat_size_bytes) AS "Est. bloat"
FROM
  pganalyze.table_bloat

SELECT
  SUM(bloat_size_bytes) AS "Est. bloat"
FROM
  pganalyze.index_bloat

spec.title: WAL size
spec.description: Total size of the write-ahead log folder.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  value
FROM
  pganalyze.sys_stats
WHERE
  metric = 'postgres_wal_size_bytes'
ORDER BY
  time DESC
LIMIT
  1

spec.title: Archive lag
spec.description: Bytes between current WAL position and last archived WAL finish LSN.

spec.rawSql:
WITH wal_config AS (
    SELECT pg_size_bytes(current_setting('wal_segment_size')) AS segment_size
)
SELECT
    pg_wal_lsn_diff(
        pg_current_wal_lsn(),
        (
            (
                substring(a.last_archived_wal FROM 1 FOR 8) || '/' ||
                substring(a.last_archived_wal FROM 9 FOR 8)
            )::pg_lsn + c.segment_size
        )
    ) AS archive_lag_bytes
FROM pg_stat_archiver a
CROSS JOIN wal_config c
WHERE a.last_archived_wal IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  pg_wal_lsn_diff(
    last(wal_lsn, collected_at),
    first(wal_lsn, collected_at)
  ) AS wal_generated_bytes
FROM
  pganalyze.database_stats
WHERE
  collected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS current_connections
FROM
  pg_stat_activity

SELECT COUNT(*) AS running_queries
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state = 'active'
  AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()

spec.title: Blocked sessions
spec.description: Queries waiting on locks held by other sessions.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS queries_waiting
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE wait_event_type = 'Lock'
  AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()

SELECT
  last(chk_requested, collected_at) - first(chk_requested, collected_at) AS requested_checkpoints_24h
FROM
  pganalyze.database_stats
WHERE
  collected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT
  irate_right(counter_agg(collected_at, tup_inserted)) * 60 AS inserted_per_min
FROM
  pganalyze.database_stats

SELECT
  value
FROM
  pganalyze.sys_stats
WHERE
  metric = 'postgres_data_size_bytes'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  value
FROM
  pganalyze.sys_stats
WHERE
  metric = 'postgres_log_size_bytes'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
pg_database_size('tem') AS "TEM",
pg_database_size('sem') AS "SEM"

SELECT
  irate_right(counter_agg(collected_at, tup_updated)) * 60 AS updated_per_min
FROM
  pganalyze.database_stats

SELECT
  irate_right(counter_agg(collected_at, tup_deleted)) * 60 AS deleted_per_min
FROM
  pganalyze.database_stats

spec.title: WAL write rate (last 24h)
spec.description: Average write-ahead log bytes written per second.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  (
    pg_wal_lsn_diff(
      last(wal_lsn, collected_at),
      first(wal_lsn, collected_at)
    )
    /
    EXTRACT(
      EPOCH FROM (
        last(collected_at, collected_at)
        - first(collected_at, collected_at)
      )
    )
  ) AS wal_bytes_per_second
FROM pganalyze.database_stats
WHERE collected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

spec.title: Temp files write rate (last 24h)
spec.description: Average temporary-file bytes written per second. High values mean queries exceed work_mem.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  (
    last(temp_bytes, collected_at)
    - first(temp_bytes, collected_at)
  )::double precision
  /
  EXTRACT(
    EPOCH FROM (
      last(collected_at, collected_at)
      - first(collected_at, collected_at)
    )
  ) AS temp_bytes_per_second
FROM pganalyze.database_stats
WHERE collected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

spec.title: Transactions / sec
spec.description: Average transactions committed and rolled back per second.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  irate_right(counter_agg(collected_at, xact_commit + xact_rollback)) * 60 AS tx_per_min
FROM
  pganalyze.database_stats

spec.title: Rolled-back transactions
spec.description: Share of transactions that were rolled back rather than committed.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  100.0 *
  irate_right(counter_agg(collected_at, xact_rollback))
  /
  NULLIF(
    irate_right(
      counter_agg(collected_at, xact_commit + xact_rollback)
    ),
    0
  ) AS rollback_pct
FROM pganalyze.database_stats;

spec.title: Idle open transactions
spec.description: Open transactions sitting idle. They hold locks and block cleanup.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS idle_in_transaction
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state = 'idle in transaction'
  AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()

spec.title: Queries / sec
spec.description: Average number of queries executed per second.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  SUM(qps) AS qps
FROM (
  SELECT
    irate_right(counter_agg(time, calls)) AS qps
  FROM pganalyze.stat_statements
  WHERE time >= now() - interval '24 hours'
  GROUP BY queryid, userid
) s

WITH per_query AS (
    SELECT
        queryid,
        userid,
        delta(counter_agg(time, total_exec_time)) AS exec_time_delta,
        delta(counter_agg(time, calls::double precision)) AS calls_delta
    FROM pganalyze.stat_statements
    WHERE time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    GROUP BY queryid, userid
)
SELECT
    SUM(exec_time_delta)
        / NULLIF(SUM(calls_delta), 0) AS avg_query_time_ms
FROM per_query
WHERE exec_time_delta >= 0
  AND calls_delta >= 0

spec.title: Idle open transactions
spec.description: Open transactions sitting idle. They hold locks and block cleanup.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS idle_in_transaction
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state = 'idle in transaction'
  AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()

spec.title: Cache hit rate
spec.description: Share of reads served from memory instead of disk. Aim for 90% or higher.

spec.rawSql:
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT
        delta(counter_agg(collected_at, blks_hit::double precision))
            AS hits_delta,
        delta(counter_agg(collected_at, blks_read::double precision))
            AS reads_delta
    FROM pganalyze.database_stats
    WHERE collected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        (100.0 * hits_delta /
         NULLIF(hits_delta + reads_delta, 0))::numeric,
        2
    ) AS avg_buffer_cache_hit_rate_pct
FROM stats

spec.title: Large table scans / min
spec.description: Full scans per minute on tables larger than 100 MB. Frequent scans often mean a missing index.

spec.rawSql:
WITH per_table AS (
  SELECT
    relid,
    irate_right(
      counter_agg(collected_at, seq_scans :: double precision)
    ) AS scans_per_second
  FROM
    pganalyze.table_stats
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    AND table_bytes > 100000000
  GROUP BY
    relid
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(scans_per_second * 60), 0) AS full_scans_per_min
FROM
  per_table

spec.title: Unused indexes
spec.description: Invalid, unused or duplicate indexes that can safely be dropped. They slow down writes without helping reads.

spec.rawSql:
WITH invalid_indexes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM pg_index i
    JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE NOT i.indisvalid
      AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
),
unused_indexes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM pg_stat_user_indexes s
    JOIN pg_index i ON i.indexrelid = s.indexrelid
    WHERE s.idx_scan = 0
      AND NOT i.indisprimary
      AND NOT i.indisunique
),
duplicate_indexes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM (
        SELECT
            indrelid,
            indkey,
            indclass,
            indcollation,
            indoption,
            indexprs,
            indpred,
            indisunique,
            am.amname
        FROM pg_index i
        JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid
        JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = c.relam
        WHERE i.indisvalid
        GROUP BY
            indrelid, indkey, indclass, indcollation,
            indoption, indexprs, indpred, indisunique, am.amname
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    ) d
)
SELECT
    (SELECT total FROM invalid_indexes) AS invalid,
    (SELECT total FROM unused_indexes) AS unused,
    (SELECT total FROM duplicate_indexes) AS duplicate
SELECT floor(current_setting('server_version_num')::int/10000) AS server_major
SELECT (current_setting('server_version_num')::int)%10000 AS server_minor
